name: Dog Trainer Toolz
tagline: Free tools and step-by-step plans to train your dog at home.
description: Free dog training tools and clear, reward-based training plans for puppies, basic commands, leash walking and common problem behaviors like barking, jumping and biting.

pillars.name: Puppy Training
pillars.blurb: Potty training, crate training, biting, chewing and socialization: everything for the first months.

pillars.name: Basic Commands
pillars.blurb: Sit, down, stay, come, leave it and getting your dog's attention, taught step by step.

pillars.name: Leash & Walks
pillars.blurb: Loose-leash walking, heel, reactivity and when to let your dog off leash.

pillars.name: Problem Behaviors
pillars.blurb: Barking, jumping, digging, guarding, separation anxiety, fear and hyperactivity, plus when to call a professional.

pillars.name: Methods & Gear
pillars.blurb: How reward-based training works, clickers, treats, harnesses, choosing a trainer and choosing the right dog.

pillars.name: Tricks & Games
pillars.blurb: Tricks, brain games and ways to tire out your dog that build a better bond.
